name: Failed Sign-in Burst
logic: 8+ failed sign-ins for a user in 10 minutes
response: Validate source IP/user, review MFA/device context, block/reset if malicious.

name: Success After Repeated Failures
logic: Successful sign-in within 30 minutes after 8+ failures from same user/IP
response: Investigate account compromise, revoke sessions, reset credentials, review subsequent activity.

name: Unexpected Country Authentication
response: Validate travel/VPN context and correlate with device, MFA and user behaviour.

name: Privileged Role Activity
logic: Administrative role/user changes in audit logs
response: Confirm change approval and investigate unauthorised privilege modification.
